name: liberta-hotel-management-system
description: Root workspace orchestrator for LIBERTA's 6 NestJS backend services — alpha-test tooling only. Docker (docker-compose.yml) remains the source of truth for packaging/deployment.

scripts.dev: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -n auth,mfa,guest,room,booking,admin -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan,white "npm run start:dev -w @liberta/auth-service" "npm run start:dev -w @liberta/mfa-service" "npm run start:dev -w @liberta/guest-service" "npm run start:dev -w @liberta/room-service" "npm run start:dev -w @liberta/booking-service" "npm run start:dev -w @liberta/admin-service"
